investigations.name: grammar
investigations.title: A human-interpretable grammar as a pluggable rule engine
investigations.description: viva-grammar reimplements the cell-behavior hypothesis grammar (Johnson, Bergman, …, Fertig & Macklin, Cell 2025) as a process-bigraph module. The engine is ABM-agnostic; host coupling lives in thin adapters. This investigation's first study proves the engine on the paper's own hypoxia example; a follow-on will wire the blueprint adapter into viva-multicell-blueprint's CPM / vertex / center-based ABMs.
investigations.question: Can the Macklin/PhysiCell cell-behavior hypothesis grammar be implemented as a generic, ABM-agnostic process that reproduces published multicellular dynamics and plugs into different agent-based models unchanged?
investigations.hypothesis: A clean-room engine that compiles the grammar's rules to the paper's Hill-function mathematics, reading abstract per-cell signals and emitting abstract behaviors, can both (a) reproduce the paper's hypoxia → motility model on a minimal reference substrate and (b) drop into the MISM blueprint's MechanicsBackend in place of its built-in RulesProcess.
